summary: A Quote subscription on the NIFTY index: the index feed gives the value, OHLC and previous close with the change worked out, and nothing an index record does not carry.

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
An HSM index record has no exchange token; the web sends a placeholder "" (fyers_mapping.py:82, exchange_token default). A value the stream does not carry is left out (lead approval 2026-11-09).

An HSM index record carries no trade, book, volume, OI or circuit; the web's quote mapper sends each as 0 (fyers_data.get(..., 0)), the desktop leaves them out, as web openalgo#2376 asks of a field the stream does not carry.
